Pune Police Book UK Citizen Under New Anti-Conversion Law

Pune Police have registered a case against a UK-based Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) cardholder and another individual under Maharashtra's new anti-conversion law. The FIR was filed following allegations of promoting religious conversion. This marks the first case registered under the state's recently enacted legislation. The accused include a 22-year-old Pune resident.
